featured_reviews.name: renzel Hendriques
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of working with Yash studio's, and I cannot express enough how thrilled I am with the entire experience. From start to finish, Yash studio's demonstrated exceptional artistry, professionalism, and an unwavering commitment to capturing unforgettable moments.
During the session itself, Yash studio's proved to be a true master of their craft. Their keen eye for composition, creative use of lighting, and ability to capture genuine emotions was truly remarkable. I was blown away by the way they effortlessly transformed ordinary settings into extraordinary backdrops for my photographs. Their attention to detail and meticulous approach to every shot left me in awe.
What impressed me even more was how comfortable Yash studio's made me feel throughout the shoot. Their friendly and warm demeanor created a relaxed atmosphere, allowing me to be my authentic self. This translated into natural and candid photographs that beautifully captured my personality and emotions. Yash studio's has an incredible talent for capturing the essence of the moment, freezing it in time for me to cherish forever.
Not only was the photography itself outstanding, but Yash studio's also delivered the final product with exceptional care and professionalism. The turnaround time was quicker than I expected, and the photographs were presented in a stunning and well-organized manner. The attention to detail in their post-processing was evident, as the images were vibrant, well-balanced, and showcased the true essence of each captured moment.
The value I received from working with Yash studio's far exceeded my expectations. Their talent, dedication, and personalized approach to each session make them stand out among other photographers. The investment I made in their services was worth every penny and more.
I wholeheartedly recommend Yash studio's to anyone seeking a photographer who not only captures remarkable images but also provides an incredible experience. They are a true professional who goes above and beyond to create timeless memories. Thank you, Yash studio's, for your exceptional work and for making this journey truly unforgettable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
We hired this photographer for two preschool events with a fixed rate agreed for both events.
On the morning of the first event, he suddenly demanded ₹500 extra for just 15 additional minutes, which was never discussed during finalization.
The quality of work was extremely poor:
Main events were missed, while irrelevant side moments were covered
Videos were blurry
No noise cancellation during speeches and parent testimonials
Overall output was unusable and disappointing
When we shared our feedback, he initially accepted his mistake. We requested to meet before the second event to clearly guide him on what needed coverage. After this, he stopped answering calls and messages.
As the second event date approached, he:
Increased the price to double the committed amount
Refused to meet or discuss
Claimed he was traveling
Asked for advance payment
Said he would only talk 2 days before the event
To cover up his poor work, he started blaming us for mismanagement, which was completely untrue.
Additional concerns:
Very poor song selection in videos
If changes are requested, he claims he is “too busy” to discuss
No studio address provided; asked us to meet on a roadside while taking advance
Claimed to bring an extra photographer, but that person was clearly inexperienced and delivered badly zoomed, awkward photos that looked like low-quality BTS shots
Overall, this was a highly unprofessional and dishonest experience.
Not recommended at all, especially for important events involving children and parents.

From the very beginning, we planned everything remotely and were working with a very short timeline — but none of that felt like an issue thanks to their professionalism, communication, and genuine passion for what they do.

Even before the wedding day, he made us feel completely at ease. Every detail was discussed clearly, and despite the distance, we felt confident that we were in good hands.
